spikes.question: Can samagent/ be packaged via pyproject.toml with only patch P2?
spikes.verdict: PASS — pyproject.toml uses [tool.setuptools.packages.find] with an explicit include list and already bundles plugins/**/plugin.yaml. Adding 'samagent' and 'samagent.*' (Patch P2) plus template package-data is sufficient.

spikes.question: Can pre_llm_call inject an ephemeral user-turn block without breaking cache byte-stability?
spikes.verdict: PASS — agent/turn_context.py _collect_pre_llm_call_context injects hook {'context': ...} into the user message via compose_user_api_content, never the system prompt, and stamps api_content on the message row so intra-turn tool loops and historical turns replay identical bytes. Patch P4 is NOT needed.

spikes.question: Do kanban profiles and delegate_task support per-task model + toolset routing with no core patch?
spikes.verdict: PASS — Both paths work without patching core: (1) kanban_swarm.SwarmWorkerSpec routes each worker to a named profile carrying its own model/provider/toolsets; (2) in-process delegate_task already accepts credentials_cfg={'model': ..., 'provider': ..., 'base_url': ..., 'request_overrides': ...} and _build_child_agent accepts toolsets and model overrides. Patch P1 is NOT needed.

spikes.question: Do pre_tool_call hooks fire inside delegated child agents (for the ownership guard)?
spikes.verdict: PASS — Delegated children are in-process AIAgent instances that execute tools through agent_runtime_helpers.invoke_tool -> _pre_tool_block_message -> _dispatch_pre_tool_call_hooks with the child's task_id and session_id. Both the fast pre_tool_call hook and the post-hoc git diff check work.

spikes.question: What is the build pipeline for dashboard-plugin dist/, and can a plugin get streaming + steer transport?
spikes.verdict: PASS — Bundled dashboard plugins (like plugins/kanban/dashboard/) use a plain JS IIFE against window.__HERMES_PLUGIN_SDK__ with zero bundler step, mount a FastAPI APIRouter via plugin_api.py at /api/plugins/<name>/ (including WebSocket routes), and push live events via hermes_cli.plugin_events.broadcast_plugin_event.

spikes.question: Does local_runtime + request_overrides support llama-server flags and JSON-schema/grammar constraints?
spikes.verdict: PASS (code path verified; live model scorecard runs via samagent.router.bench_model on target hardware) — hermes_cli/local_runtime/presets.py generates llama-server flags (including --spec-type ngram-mod) and chat_completion_helpers forwards request_overrides/extra_body (response_format / grammar) plus tools/schema_sanitizer.py normalizes schemas for llama.cpp's grammar converter.

spikes.question: Can pre_verify run L1–L4 and block 'finish' with a useful message?
spikes.verdict: PASS — get_pre_verify_continue_message invokes registered pre_verify hooks with changed_paths and final_response; returning {'action': 'continue', 'message': ...} keeps the agent in its loop up to agent.max_verify_nudges.

spikes.question: Can the kanban_swarm blackboard serve as the run's task channel with the ledger as its durable store?
spikes.verdict: PASS — kanban_swarm.create_swarm atomically creates the root->workers->verifier->synthesizer DAG in SQLite and post_blackboard_update/latest_blackboard exchange structured JSON facts on the root task.

spikes.question: Does the live agent actually defer tools via the tool_search bridge by default?
spikes.verdict: PASS — Mystery solved: our earlier probe lacked snowballstemmer in the temp venv, causing tools/tool_search_catalog.py to raise ModuleNotFoundError (caught under logging.WARNING). With snowballstemmer installed, assemble_tool_defs activates by default, replacing session_search, todo_list, and process_manage with the tool_search/describe/call bridge (reducing resolved coding schema tokens from 9,121 to 8,291).
